references.text: Lot's daughters bore sons to him: Moab and Ben-Ammi, who became the ancestor of the Ammonites. This explains why God calls their land 'the inheritance of Lot's children.'
The same command was given regarding Moab, who were also descendants of Lot. Israel was not to attack them or take their land.
Summary that Israel obeyed God's command and did not approach the land of the Ammonites.
Jephthah refers to this story when he defends Israel's right to the land they had taken and confirms that they did not seize land from the Ammonites.
The account of Lot's daughters and the origin of the Ammonites, which explains the kinship between Israel and the Ammonites through Lot.
The Ammonites are mentioned as a people who existed alongside Israel, in line with God's promise to give them their own land.
